D1.description: Basic syntax / direct simulation / elementary implementation.

D2.description: Standard basic algorithms with light reasoning.

D3.description: Routine OI algorithms; one main idea, moderate implementation.

D4.description: Requires nontrivial modeling, combination of standard techniques, or careful implementation.

D5.description: Strong modeling/insight or algorithmic optimization; substantial contest problem.

D6.description: Advanced technique, multi-step insight, or demanding proof/implementation.

D7.description: High-level national-selection style; deep modeling, optimization, or composition.

D8.description: Top-tier OI difficulty; exceptional insight, technique depth, or implementation complexity.

knowledge.question: How much prerequisite algorithmic knowledge is required?

insight.question: How hard is the key breakthrough to discover?

modeling.question: How hard is it to define the correct abstraction/state?

optimization.question: How hard is moving from brute/partial to target complexity?

debugging.question: How difficult are corner cases and failure localization?

rules: Always preserve native platform difficulty/rating separately.
Never claim exact equivalence between platform rating systems.
Tutor band is a calibrated internal estimate, not a platform conversion.
For IOI-style tasks, record entry/partial/full difficulty when the score ladder materially differs.
